resources.string: A native USB workspace for your MX Creative Keypad
Connect automatically when this keypad is attached
Physical keys and LCD updates stay active. Tap to return to MX Pocket.
Tap to open the app selected on your keypad.
If the app did not open, tap to try again.
Could not open the shortcut directly. Tap to try again.

On an unlocked phone, each physical keypad press can open a saved favorite, a Phone shortcut, or a camera viewfinder without a notification tap. Opening the viewfinder does not take a photo or record. Android requires “Display over other apps”, which also allows drawing over other apps. MX Pocket does not draw overlays. Leave this off to use notifications, or revoke access in Android settings at any time.
Unlock the phone and press the keypad shortcut again.
Shortcut no longer available. Press the key on the connected keypad again.
Choose custom image for all nine keys
Not connected. USB permission and a compatible HID descriptor are required.
Source-supported profile: one 480x480 panel, nine 118x118 visible key regions. Physical behavior has not been verified on this phone.

Checks the visible Teams call controls with a connected keypad and the Teams option enabled. A physical center key press can operate the labeled meeting microphone. Does not read chat text, join, answer, or hang up.

Responds to navigation keys for scrolling, focus and activation. When touch exploration is on, Previous and Next send swipes to TalkBack and may interrupt an ongoing gesture. A key you assign can run your Android accessibility shortcut. With the separate Studio camera-controls option, a physical Studio key can click a labeled shutter, record or stop button in your default camera. Does not record screen content, keystrokes or notifications.
Lets MX Pocket keypad keys tap OneNote draw tools such as Pen and Eraser while OneNote is on screen. MX Pocket never reads your notes.
